structured.answer: After 8 years I'd have about 68,853 ₪ ("נשאר בידיים", at 500 ₪ a month, of which 48,000 ₪ is what I put in). For 4 years the calculator gives no number for self-employed people: it only says that before 6 years there's no calculation yet and you pay tax.

stuck.why: The big number 25,725 sits above an empty dashed box, so I first took it as my 4-year amount. Its label 'אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך' is only underneath, and I had to scroll to see it.
The fields rearranged and moved sideways; the return field ended up where the fee field had been.
